newsitem.title: CHINA: China sculptor carves huge statue after Deng dies.
newsitem.headline: China sculptor carves huge statue after Deng dies.

text.p: A Chinese sculptor has toiled round-the-clock to complete a huge statue of Deng Xiaoping since China's paramount leader died this week at 92, officials said on Saturday.
Chinese sculptor Bai Lansheng began carving the statue from clay that will be cast in bronze about two months ago, an official for the China news service said by telephone.
He was now racing to complete the task after the man who ruled China for the past 18 years died at 9.08 p.m. (1308 GMT) on Wednesday, the official said.
A photograph of the statue showed Deng posing as if moving forward in mid-stride and with a half-smile on his face. The massive figure, near completion, towers to the height of about five men.
Officials refused to say where the statue will stand when it is completed.

Such a monument to Deng would have been impossible in the lifetime of the diminutive communist revolutionary whose reforms created a fledgling economic superpower but who abhorred the personality cult that surrounded his predecessor Mao Zedong.
